calibration_screen.rule: when no common plateau exists, FAIL takes precedence if any contiguous five-point window has a resolved sign or plateau failure; otherwise UNRESOLVED

formal_ladder_selection.selection_rule: first (smallest-epsilon) contiguous five-point window for which all 3 directions x 2 responses are above their independent floors and pass the registered 5% median-slope plateau and sign gates

runtime_artifact_audit.gpu_uuid_policy: recorded_for_each_kernel; physical T4 UUID is not a cross-kernel equality gate
